Oasis Springs.blurb: An oasis nestled in the austere beauty of the western desert, this haven of eclectic culture is fringed by countless soaring palms, and lent vibrant color through impossibly lush landscaping. Oasis Springs offers relaxing retreats from the sun to any traveler who discovers it.

hoods.Bedrock Strait: Residents of this delightfully kitschy neighborhood take pride in their billboards and lawn gnomes. And who wouldn't love getting to say hello to Barry the Brontosaurus every morning?
hoods.Parched Prospect: This neighborhood is your quintessential desert-living experience with bustling tumbleweeds and cacti as far as the eye can see!
hoods.Skyward Palms: This upscale gated community offers its residents all the warm, wild benefits of living in the desert along with the luxury of endless green grass.
hoods.Mirage Canyon: Mirage Canyon is Oasis Springs' true oasis. Parched visitors passing through can always delight in seeing the gorgeous rushing waterfall and a well-appreciated pitstop.

Newcrest.blurb: Don't let the abundance of space fool you. Take a look around, admire the wonderful scenery, and explore the endless possibilities. Do you see it? This is your whole new world! What are you waiting for?

hoods.Bridgeview: This family-friendly neighborhood has a lovely picnic area and a striking city skyline backdrop.
hoods.Llama Lagoon: With lakeside walkways and public playground equipment, this neighborhood's just the right amount of cosmopolitan.

Granite Falls.blurb: Take your Sims on a vacation to experience the clear skies and piney mountain air! Pitch your tent, explore the woods, and experience the wonders of nature… like a Sim in a bear suit?

hoods.Granite Falls Forest: Experience the true perfection of nature by exploring the lush and beautiful Granite Falls Forest.

Magnolia Promenade.blurb: Welcome to a world in which beautiful scenery meets metropolitan life! Magnolia Promenade offers fantastic views and a top of the line shopping experience for customers and entrepreneurs alike.

Windenburg.blurb: Take ye olde deep breath and enjoy the mountain air. This green, expansive playground has got it all: lush countryside, serene and rocky cliffs, a quaint village with remnants of the old world all nestled around the modern shore side business center.

hoods.Olde Platz: What Olde Platz lacks in greenery it makes up for in charming cobblestone. Live, work and play in the rich, cultural history of the oldest part of Windenburg.
hoods.Lykke Center / University of Windenburg: Fresh, new, and arrestingly shiny, Lykke Centre is where new commercial enterprise in Windenburg thrives.
hoods.Windslar: Wide open spaces and a chateau or two. Visit or live in Windslar for a delectable taste of countryside living.
hoods.The Crumbling Isle: The Crumbling Isle is a bit of a misnomer for this part of town. There's nothing here but glorious high-end real estate as far as the eye can see.

San Myshuno.blurb: Welcome to San Myshuno! Every day is an adventure on the streets of San Myshuno.

hoods.Spice Market: A family neighborhood famous for its Spice Festival, Flea Market and dockland views.
hoods.Arts Quarter: Home to the Humor and Hijinks Festival, the bohemian Arts Quarter is beloved by musicians, artists and all manner of creative types.
hoods.Fashion District: Popular with young and trendy Sims, the Fashion District is also home to the Romance Festival and GeekCon.
hoods.Uptown: The luxurious heart of the City, Uptown is home to the rich, powerful... and slightly odd.
hoods.Myshuno Meadows: Surrounded by both trees and the cityscape, Myshuno Meadows is a great place for a relaxed wedding or outdoor birthday party. Centered on Barnabas Skye's old Observatory, part of the area has been converted into an event space while still retaining the original telescope.

Selvadorada.blurb: Enjoy learning about the Selvadorada culture, or explore the jungle's hidden secrets. But be prepared! It won't be an easy trek through the jungle.

hoods.Puerto Llamante Marketplace: Come enjoy the sights and sounds of Selvadorada!
hoods.Belomisia Jungle: The jungle is teeming with wondrous sights and hidden dangers. Brave adventurers can explore the ruins of the ancient Omiscans. Skilled Sims and those equipped with gear from the marketplace will do well here.

Brindleton Bay.blurb: Discover the coastal shores of Brindleton Bay, a new world where your Sims and their pets can live and enjoy outdoor activities.

hoods.Sable Square: The cultural center of the city, Sable Square is ideal for both cats and dogs. These people love their pets so much, they've built a monument to them right in the middle of town!
hoods.Whiskerman's Wharf: A favorite hangout for the Bay's feline citizens, who can be found climbing around down at the docks. Whiskerman's Wharf is also enjoyed by fishermen and tourists alike.
hoods.Cavalier Cove: Known for its hiking trails and sprawling coastal properties, Cavalier Cove is the perfect place to go exploring or chase seagulls with an adventurous pup!
hoods.Deadgrass Isle: Once the site of a mysterious shipwreck, the Deadgrass Isle is now home to the world-famous Brindleton Light and the city's largest population of indigenous strays. Lately, however, there have been some rumors about strange visitors after sundown…

Del Sol Valley.blurb: A densely populated city brimming with opportunities to make it big!

hoods.Mirage Park: With reasonably priced homes and so close to downtown, Mirage Park is the perfect place for an up and coming star to start their rise to fame.
hoods.The Pinnacles: Fit for the rich and famous, The Pinnacles boast the most expensive homes in all of Del Sol Valley. If you want to live here you need to make it big!
hoods.Starlight Boulevard: When it comes to night life Starlight Boulevard can not be beat. Where only the most famous Sims have access to the most exclusive night club in town. It is where the who's who of the industry come to show off.

StrangerVille.blurb: The only thing stranger than the people is the flora! StrangerVille is a quiet little town with a strange problem. The residents are very friendly, but at night things start to get more interesting.

hoods.StrangerVille Plaza: Visit the StrangerVille Information Center. This place is way more interesting than the Secret Lab.
hoods.Shady Acres: Boasting the most beautiful view StrangerVille has to offer, stay at Shady Acres and you too can wonder where all this wealth comes from.

Sulani.blurb: The gorgeous Sulani island chain welcomes all to a life of blue oceans and friendly neighbors. The main islands show off the many walks of life from the community centered Ohan'ali Town, to the more lavish upscale Lani St. Taz, and even down to the seemingly vacant Mua Pel'am. All around is the beauty of nature no matter where you look.

hoods.Mua Pel'am: Nature rules this island, from the active volcano to the flowing waterfall and down into the depths of the secluded cave. This remote destination in the Sulani island chain is the place for exploring the beauty of nature.

Glimmerbrook.blurb: The quiet town of Glimmerbrook may have more to it than meets the eye...

hoods.The Magic Realm: The Magic Realm is the source of all magic. Unfortunately, it is slowly being pulled apart by the swirling vortex surrounding it. The only thing that is keeping it together is the balance between the three houses of magic.

hoods.University of Britechester: Come tour the historic University of Britechester where a budding artist can flourish!
hoods.Foxbury Institute: Come visit the innovative campus of Foxbury to see if a future in technology is right for you.
hoods.Gibbs Hill: Gibbs Hill is nestled in the center of Britechester right between the two universities: Foxbury Institute and the University of Britechester. It was the first center of activity in Britechester and its famous Laurel Library has stayed a key location for many students to study and learn.

Evergreen Harbor.blurb: Sandwiched between rolling hills of evergreen forest on one side and the waters of the Willupette Sound on the other, Evergreen Harbor used to be the industrial hub of the region. However, as the world changed around it, the region has struggled to keep up. Evergreen Harbor now stands on the precipice of making its own future. The only question is: what kind of future will it be?

hoods.Grims Quarry: The quaint suburbs near the historic quarry is a sweet destination for any evergreen enthusiast.
hoods.Conifer Station: What happens when the trains stop running? Downtown Evergreen, affectionately known to locals as Conifer Station, may be a bit quieter nowadays, but residents will tell you that the defunct train station and unsightly storage tanks hide a hard-working community eager to improve their little corner of the world.
hoods.Port Promise: This smoggy old port may make you gag, but it's an adequate place to learn about industrialization.

Mt. Komorebi.blurb: Locals have enjoyed the healing hot springs of Mt. Komorebi for centuries. Now, thanks to the modern snow sports resort in Yukimatsu, everyone else can, too! The region has become a hotspot for tourists looking for a vacation that's equal parts relaxing and adventurous.

hoods.Wakaba: Like its namesake, Wakaba is young, new, and bright as the leaves of a tree in early springtime. This small town is up-and-coming in the region, home to beautiful, sleek new homes and an attractive town center featuring Mt. Komorebi's official mascot: Yamachan.
hoods.Senbamachi: Senbamachi, the town of a thousand leaves, is the oldest in the region. Many locals enjoy the town's connection to nature, especially with the bamboo forests surrounding the town and unique spritely creatures that make a home in their leaves.
hoods.Yukimatsu: The true beauty of the countryside can be seen from Yukimatsu, named for its snow-covered pines. Located on the slopes of Mt. Komorebi, this area offers gorgeous vacation rentals, a variety of snow sports, untamed wilderness, and a peaceful Onsen Bathhouse getaway.

Henford-on-Bagley.blurb: From the natural beauty of Cordelia Falls to the clear, brisk currents of the River Bagley, the mingling of earth and water makes Henford-on-Bagley a lovely place to visit, but perhaps an even lovelier place to live. Villagers here connect with the history of the land while finding friendship in the furry and feathery creatures that inhabit the woods.

hoods.Finchwick: Nestled along the River Bagley, the old mill village of Finchwick prides itself on its bustling and close-knit community. Its historic square features a pub and quaint stalls amid a flowering garden, perfect for a little window shopping.
hoods.Old New Henford: An area that boasts rolling hills, lush estates, and a small community garden, Old New Henford is perhaps best known for its historical naming woes.
hoods.The Bramblewood: The wooded area on the outskirts of Henford has a storybook-like feel and is where the most wild animals can be found, such as wild birds, rabbits, and foxes.

Copperdale.blurb: Once renowned for its booming mining industry, the town of Copperdale, quaint and historic, lay nestled on the banks of Lake LaSuli. With academics and adventures abound, Copperdale is now home to many families seeking a small-town life with big-city dreams for themselves and their teens.

hoods.Rockridge Heights: Home to Copperdale High, Rockridge Heights is the town's standard-bearer for academia across generations. It's a beloved school ground for quintessential teen moments and college preparation.
hoods.Prescott Square: Named after Copperdale's founder, Jasper Prescott, this town square is a quaint hub for all afterschool hangouts.
hoods.Plumbite Cove: Settled on Lake LaSuli sits Plumbite Cove, a once-popular location for its mining of rare gems. After the mines shut down, the town turned this picturesque outlook into a waterfront fairground.

San Sequoia.blurb: San Sequoia began as a small fishing town, then became a hub of the fishing and canning industry. Today, San Sequoia is home to cozy streets, a beautiful park with gardens, and quiet suburban neighborhoods. It's the perfect place to raise a family!

hoods.Anchorpoint Wharf: Once the center of a bustling fishing and canning industry, Anchorpoint Wharf is known now as a vibrant area downtown featuring a movie theater, parklets, and more. There's plenty to keep all ages entertained.
hoods.Gilbert Gardens: Gilbert Gardens' gorgeous park was once owned by Gilbert Gilberts, a land developer who helped establish the area. Now, it's the perfect locale for family trips to the gardens.
hoods.Hopewell Hills: Hopewell Hills is a cozy spot away from the hustle and bustle of town; the perfect place for anyone who wants, well, space! If the suburbs are your idea of paradise, you've found it here in this quiet neighborhood.

Chestnut Ridge.blurb: This community formed when several groups embraced their mutual connection to Horses and the land. The area soon became known as a hub for all things Equestrian, set against a beautiful and expansive landscape. Over time, the area became famous for another endeavor, as the rich soil brought in the new enterprise of Nectar Making.

hoods.New Appaloosa: The historic New Appaloosa serves as a hub for Horse Riders, Ranchers, and Nectar Makers. Whether competing at the Hay Now! Equestrian Center, enjoying a night out at the dance hall, or savoring Nectar with good friends, this old watering hole has something for everyone.
hoods.Riders' Glen: Watched over by the Trusty Steed Rock, known as "Ol' Biscuit" to the locals, Riders' Glen has been home to generations of Ranchers and Nectar Makers.
hoods.Galloping Gulch: Lauded as one of the go-to regions for Horse Riding, the Gulch is chockfull of gorgeous trails and stunning outlooks.

Tomarang.blurb: Grown from humble roots off the coast of Shih Sea, Tomarang is lively with local fare, community chaos, and legends of lore. Known for its tight-knit communities and sun-filled shared spaces, Tomarang is a lush landscape of possibilities.

hoods.Morensong: A bustling neighborhood with pockets of idyllic peace and nooks of neighborly nuance! Morensong is the spot for vibrant communities to thrive, day or night.
hoods.Koh Sahpa: Neighbors with nature or other tenants, Koh Sahpa offers a more relaxed lifestyle along the river.

Ravenwood.blurb: Things always get a little spooky in Ravenwood. Whispering Glen is perhaps the most "normal" part of the area, Crow's Crossing village is clearly quite haunted, and Mourningvale is where things get extra ethereal. Sometimes Grim even stops by!

hoods.Crow's Crossing: Crow's Crossing is a village founded by Moppy the Goat and rumored to be frequented by Ghosts and regular hauntings.
hoods.Whispering Glen: Nestled in the rolling hills of Ravenwood's countryside, Whispering Glen offers a quiet, rural locale for those hoping to take a step away from all the local hauntings and into a slow-paced lifestyle.
hoods.Mourningvale: There's something otherworldly about Mourningvale. No matter the reason, many Ghosts choose to call this place home. The Grim Reaper has even been known to wander through now and then!

Nordhaven.blurb: This northern coastal city is known for its thriving, independent local businesses and the enchanting beauty of its cold seasons. Whether you seek to make your business flourish or just want to practice your hobbies with a cozy community, you will always find an opportunity here.

hoods.Gammelvik: Take a walk down the historic streets of Gammelvik and immerse yourself in the culture of Nordhaven's oldest district. Locals here like to take it slow, travel to work on their vintage bikes, and take long strolls by the old canals at night.
hoods.Iverstad: Originally the industrial district of the city, Iverstad has recently turned into a natural settling spot for ambitious and stylish Sims. Many of its old factories have been repurposed as living spaces.

Gibbi Point.blurb: It's been many years since Gibbi Point experienced the Great Wave, a seismic event that carved out unique landmarks and created lush flora and fauna. Its many underground hot springs keep the waters tepid and inviting, allowing for swimming and water activities year-round.

hoods.Wanderwood Wilds: Life in Wanderwood Wilds sure is a blast - literally! Hothead Rock Geyser may be the main draw to the area, but there's more in these woods than meets the eye.
hoods.Jellyfish Junction: Jellyfish Junction is known for its unique, artistic vibe, attracting not only creatives, but also kayakers and tourists eager to explore.
hoods.Crystal Valley: Once a bustling gold mining community, Crystal Valley earned its name after an unusual occurrence took place: overnight, the Scoop's Gold Mine dried up only to be replaced by crystals!

Ondarion.blurb: The regal Kingdom of Ondarion takes its name from the emerald sea that unites its three great shores. Together its cultures have forged a grand legacy of Nobility and aristocratic Dynasties, which has lasted for countless generations.

hoods.Dambele: Known for its vibrant streets, communal spaces and a strong tradition of painting and crafting, Dambele is a warm and welcoming place.
hoods.Verdemar: Fierce and untamed like its people, Verdemar is a place of bold contrasts. Rowdy pirates and educated Nobles have both called it home throughout history.
hoods.Bellacorde: Class, opulence and elegance. In Bellacorde everything is romantic, beautiful...and crazy expensive.
